contents.name: JsonPath
contents.description: RFC 9535-compliant JSONPath to extract the time series value.

contents.name: TimestampPath
contents.description: RFC 9535-compliant JSONPath to extract the timestamp. Optional for flat payloads.

contents.name: IsBatchPayload
contents.description: Indicates if the value and timestamp JSONPaths resolve to arrays (e.g. $.array[*].value).

contents.name: Topic
contents.description: Topic from which the JSON payload is received.
